raw.title: Business Analyst / Product Owner
raw.description:
Business Analyst / Product Owner

Trinetix is looking for a skilled Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in SCRUM and Agile delivery practices. The role combines business analysis and product ownership responsibilities, including defining and prioritizing product requirements, managing the backlog, and translating business needs into clear, actionable user stories and solutions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role
  • Strong knowledge of SCRUM methodology and practical experience working in Agile environments
  • Advanced English level, with strong communication skills in a professional environment
  • Advanced Ukrainian level, with strong communication skills in a professional environment
  • Proven experience collaborating with stakeholders, development teams, and product leadership
  • Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs based on business value and priorities
  • Experience with backlog refinement, defining acceptance criteria, and writing clear, actionable user stories
  • Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical requirements
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working with tools such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Excel, Confluence or SharePoint, and Miro

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience owning a product backlog or acting as a Product Owner
  • Legal domain knowledge or experience working on legal-related products or projects
  • Experience supporting or leading sprint planning and other Agile ceremonies
  • Understanding of the product development lifecycle and software development processes
  • Understanding of technical terminology and ability to communicate effectively with development teams
  • Experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams
  • Familiarity with enterprise-level workflows or large-scale Agile environments

Core Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, product leadership, and development teams to understand business needs and define product requirements
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and aligned with business goals
  • Lead and facilitate backlog refinement sessions and support effective sprint planning
  • Define clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements that are actionable for development teams
  • Prioritize requirements based on business value, stakeholder needs, dependencies, and delivery priorities
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements while maintaining alignment between business and engineering teams
  • Support product decision-making by identifying gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across stakeholders and cross-functional teams
  • Maintain product and requirements documentation using tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence/SharePoint, Miro, etc.
  • Support Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the product development process

About Us  

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world. 

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, we have a global team of over 1,000 professionals and delivery centers across Europe, the United States, and Argentina. We partner with leading global brands, delivering innovative digital solutions across Fintech, Professional Services, Logistics, Healthcare, and Agriculture. 

Our operations are driven by a strong business vision, a people-first culture, and a commitment to responsible growth. We actively give back to the community through various CSR activities and adhere to international principles for sustainable development and business ethics. 

 

To learn more about how we collect, process, and store your personal data, please review our Privacy Notice: https://www.trinetix.com/corporate-policies/privacy-notice

Als Chief of Staff (m/w/d) arbeitest du unmittelbar mit unserer Geschäftsführung zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Eberhardt Service Group. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, schaffst Transparenz und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Entscheidungen konsequent in die Organisation übersetzt und umgesetzt werden. 
Dabei bist du weit mehr als eine Schnittstelle: Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung, Impulsgeber und Umsetzungstreiber – mit einem unternehmensweiten Blick auf Performance, Prozesse und Wachstum. 

  • Du bist die zentrale Kommunikations- und Steuerungsschnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften.
  • Du übersetzt strategische Prioritäten gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung in konkrete Ziele, Projekte und Maßnahmen.
  • Du steuerst und verfolgst unternehmensweite Initiativen und stellst sicher, dass Verantwortlichkeiten, KPIs und Deadlines klar definiert und eingehalten werden.
  • Du etablierst und moderierst regelmäßige Management- und Performance-Reviews mit den verantwortlichen Führungskräften.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über die Performance der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und bereitest Management-Reports, Analysen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor.
  • Du identifizierst Engpässe, Ineffizienzen und Risiken und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen konkrete Lösungen.
  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und Strukturen und treibst deren Standardisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung voran.
  • Du entwickelst Strukturen und Prozesse so weiter, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum effizient und skalierbar bleiben.
  • Du übernimmst ausgewählte strategische Sonderprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Du agierst als Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv und bringst eine unternehmensweite Perspektive in Entscheidungen ein.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Entscheidungen konkrete Maßnahmen entstehen – und aus Maßnahmen messbare Ergebnisse.


Dein Profil

Für uns ist weniger entscheidend, welchen Jobtitel du bisher hattest. Entscheidend ist, dass du unternehmerisch denkst, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell verstehst und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmst. 
Idealerweise bringst du mit: 

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, idealerweise inBetriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre, Rechtswissenschaftenoder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer strategischen oder operativen Steuerungsrolle, beispielsweise inOperations, Unternehmensberatung, Unternehmensentwicklung, Projekt-/Programmmanagement oder als Chief of Staff
  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für unternehmerische Zusammenhänge, Prozesse und operative Werttreiber
  • Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu strukturieren und auf die entscheidenden Punkte zu reduzieren
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit KPIs, Performance Management und Reporting
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsstärke, insbesondere im Austausch mit Führungskräften
  • Die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen und gleichzeitig konsequent auf Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse hinzuarbeiten
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Pragmatismus und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und datenbasierten Analysen
  • Erfahrung in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung im Facility Management oder in einer vergleichbaren operativen Dienstleistungsbranche ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss


Warum wir?

Bei uns übernimmst du nicht einfach eine neue Position. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, direkt an der weiteren Entwicklung eines wachsenden Unternehmens mitzuwirken und gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung Strukturen, Prozesse und Prioritäten aktiv zu gestalten. 
Was dich bei uns erwartet: 

  • Direkter Einfluss & Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, bekommst tiefen Einblick in unsere Unternehmenssteuerung und kannst Entscheidungen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Wachstum & Entwicklung: Vielfältige Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen und mit uns zusammenwachsen kannst.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine Kultur, in der deine Ideen ausdrücklich gefragt sind.
  • Moderne Arbeitswelt: Moderne Arbeitsmittel, ein modernes Büro und flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Gleitzeit.
  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung sowie ein Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.
  • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Ein umfangreiches Angebot rund um Gesundheit, Fitness und Mental Health.
  • Starkes Miteinander: Eine offene, kollegiale Unternehmenskultur, echte Wertschätzung, regelmäßige Teamevents sowie kostenlose Getränke.
Mehr als wirtschaftlicher Erfolg: Die Chance, mit deiner Arbeit einen echten Beitrag zu Nachhaltigkeit und sozialem Engagement zu leisten.

KLINGT NACH DIR? 
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. 
Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Facility Managements – nachhaltig, digital und kundenfokussiert.

raw.title: Founding Engineer - atmo (Berlin-based / Hybrid)
raw.description:
At atmo, we've built a core AI product at the intersection of agricultural transition and green finance. As an early-stage company moving from first rollout to scale, we're looking for a hands-on Founding Engineer to join our founding team and help build the AI backbone of our product.

Over the past year, we've deliberately evolved from a pure data product into an AI-first platform. AI is now central to everything we do - from ingesting messy, real-world agricultural data to unlocking new financing flows for sustainable farming. We're looking for someone who wants to get hands-on: building and managing the AI agents that power the product, and working closely with our CSO to turn science models into shipped features.

About atmo

atmo is building the infrastructure for financing the transition of agriculture.

Agriculture is facing massive pressure to adapt - from climate change and rising input costs to new technologies and changing market requirements. Yet farmers and their financing partners often lack the data, tools and business cases needed to make the right investment decisions.

atmo is an AI-powered Agriculture Finance OS that brings farm, climate and financial data together to turn complex agricultural transition investments into clear, bankable business cases. Our platform helps farmers identify profitable transition opportunities, assess ROI and financing needs, access relevant solution providers and generate bank-ready financing reports. For banks and other financial institutions, atmo provides the data and decision intelligence needed to confidently finance the next generation of agricultural investments.

We work across the agricultural ecosystem, including farmers, banks, solution providers and food companies, and are already active in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with partnerships and pilots across leading financial and agricultural organisations.

Founded in Berlin in 2023, atmo is backed by leading investors, accelerators and non-dilutive funding programmes. We are a lean, ambitious team combining deep expertise in agriculture, finance, climate science, AI and B2B SaaS - with the goal of making agricultural transition investable at scale.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Build, run and continuously improve the LLM pipelines at the heart of atmo's product - classifying farm records, soil samples and financial statements, extracting structured data from them, and generating bank-ready reports - from prompting and orchestration to evaluation and monitoring
  • Own the platform end-to-end: a Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js web apps and the AWS infrastructure they run on
  • Partner closely with our CSO on the scientific engine, defining the interface between science and product and turning new models into production-ready features
  • Make AI outputs trustworthy: evaluations, guardrails and clear provenance, so every number in a financing case can be traced back to its source
  • Ship fast and iterate constantly, using modern AI tooling to move with a small, high-leverage team

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on builder - you'd rather be in the codebase than in a meeting
  • Strong Python backend depth (FastAPI or similar, SQL, background jobs), comfortable across the stack in TypeScript/Next.js and owning infrastructure on AWS
  • Practical experience running LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes: structured extraction, evaluation, cost and latency, handling failures gracefully
  • Comfortable working directly with scientific/domain experts, like our CSO, to turn models into shipped features
  • Fast-paced, get-it-done mindset - thrives in ambiguity and on a lean team, and takes ownership of technical decisions, not just tickets
  • Mission-aligned: genuine interest in climate, sustainable agriculture, and green finance
  • Bonus: exposure to fintech, agritech, or applied climate/agricultural science; German helps, as much of our farm data is German

Benefits

Why atmo

Building at atmo means shaping both the technology and the science behind it, side by side with the founding team. This role gives you the chance to:

  • Own the AI and data layer of a real climate-impact product, with real farmers and banks on the other end
  • Work side by side with the founding team and our CSO, shaping both product and science
  • A startup-stage compensation package with meaningful equity and substantial ownership from day oneSmall team (5 FTE), real impact, no layers

📍 Location: Hybrid, with a preference for London / Berlin
🌱 Womxn are encouraged to apply

If you're excited to build the AI and systems behind real climate and finance impact - we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing (m/f/d)
description: About Placetel We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future. Tasks Your role As Growth Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing you own paid acquisition at Placetel. You bring in the trials and the paying customers that our self-service growth model runs on – with real budget responsibility, across Google, Meta and every channel we have not tested yet. One thing up front, because it shapes how we work: winning SMB customers in Germany looks far more like winning customers for a DTC brand than like classic enterprise B2B. High volume, short consideration cycles, creative-led, measured daily. That is how we run growth – and that is the mindset we are hiring for. What you will do Own our paid acquisition budget end to end – strategy, channel mix, allocation and daily optimisation – and be accountable for the outcome. Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta, plus additional channels such as LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, native, affiliate and comparison portals. Manage to unit economics, not vanity metrics: trials, trial-to-paid, CAC, payback period and LTV/CAC are your scoreboard. Build a systematic testing cadence – audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, creative angles – with clear hypotheses, decision rules and documented learnings. Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategist: you brief which angles to test, you read the results, you decide what scales and what dies. Own tracking, attribution and measurement together with our analytics and eCommerce colleagues – GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, conversion values, offline conversion uploads from the CRM. Optimise the full path from ad to trial to paid customer: landing pages, signup flow, offers and pricing tests – together with Growth, Product and Sales. Open up channels we do not run yet and decide quickly whether they earn a permanent budget line. Report performance transparently and in plain language: what worked, what did not, what we do next. Requirements Who we are looking for Several years of hands-on performance marketing with genuine budget responsibility – ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in a DTC or high-velocity consumer brand. Both together is the strongest profile we can imagine for this role. Pro in one channel, solid in the rest. You are the person others ask about Google Ads or Meta, and you can competently run the other channels yourself. You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary. Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to. A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it. Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared. Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee. Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs; you need to feel the language they are being sold in. A degree in marketing, business, business informatics or a comparable field – or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself. Optional and nice to have Experience with free-trial or freemium subscription models and self-service checkout. Experience with comparison portals, affiliate and marketplace channels in Germany. Experience running paid in more than one market or language. Benefits What we offer Full ownership of a meaningful acquisition budget and direct, visible impact on growth and revenue. A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality. A company that is deliberately building a digital, self-service growth model – you will not be fighting the organisation to run modern growth. Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance. Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI. Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included. Open, collegial company culture with regular team events. title: Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d)
description: Dein neuer Job Unsere Vision ist eine offene, nachhaltige und friedliche Gesellschaft, in der Gutes tun mit Wirkung das gemeinsame Handeln leitet. Um dazu unseren Beitrag zu leisten, haben wir PHINEO als gemeinnützige Plattform für strategisches gesellschaftliches Engagement aufgebaut. Gesellschaftliche Herausforderungen lassen sich heute nur gemeinsam lösen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Unternehmen, Stiftungen, Sozialunternehmen, öffentlichen Institutionen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen daran, sektorübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zu stärken und mehr Wirkung zu erzielen. Für unser Team in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Beratungs-, Netzwerk- und Gestaltungskompetenz miteinander verbindet, als Senior Berater*in und Programm-Manager*in Kooperationen & Collective Impact (m/w/d) . Deine Aufgaben • Du bringst Akteur*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft, Philanthropie und öffentlichem Sektor gezielt zusammen, um Kooperationen mit gesellschaftlichem Impact anzuregen. Dafür entwickelst du neue Formen der sektorübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit. Parallel gestaltest und moderierst du etablierte Dialogformate im analogen und digitalen Raum. • Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei IMPACT COLLECTIVES, unserem neuen Angebot, das Impact Startups mit Unternehmen, Investor*innen und weiteren Enablern aus Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und Zivilgesellschaft themenspezifisch verbinden wird und damit strukturellen Wandel entlang der großen gesellschaftlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit vorantreibt. • Du leitest unsere Corporate Citizenship Arbeitsgruppe , entwickelst sie strategisch weiter, gewinnst neue Unternehmen für die Mitwirkung. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Vertreter*innen aus Wirtschaft, Zivilgesellschaft und öffentlicher Hand Impulse für eine wirksame gesellschaftliche Verantwortung von Unternehmen. • Du konzipierst, akquirierst und verantwortest Beratungs- und Kooperationsprojekte. Beispielsweise berätst du Startups, die wissen möchten, wie sie mehr Impact erzielen oder Investor*innen finden können, oder begleitest Kooperationen zwischen Unternehmen und Nonprofits prozessual wie inhaltlich. • Du steuerst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der Konzeption über das Partnermanagement bis zur Umsetzung und Auswertung. Handlungsleitend sind für dich der angestrebte gesellschaftliche Mehrwert und eine wirtschaftliche Umsetzung. Bei der Arbeit bist du selbstverständlich nicht auf dich allein gestellt. Vielmehr bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das verschiedene Kompetenzen und Perspektiven vereint. Das bringst Du mit • Du setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für gesellschaftliche Transformation, nachhaltiges Wirtschaften und die Zusammenarbeit von Akteur*innen aus unterschiedlichen gesellschaftlichen Bereichen ein. • Du bringst die Energie, Überzeugungskraft und Empathie mit, die es braucht, um Vertrauen aufzubauen und Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen. Auch skeptische Akteur*innen kannst du inspirieren und aktivieren. • Du bringst Beratungserfahrung mit, idealerweise mit Startups, Investor*innen oder Unternehmen zu Fragen rund um Strategie oder Organisationentwicklung. Daher kannst du Beratungsprozesse konzipieren, eigenständig durchführen und zu belastbaren Ergebnissen führen. • Du hast in der Vergangenheit bereits Netzwerke aufgebaut oder intensiv betreut, idealerweise mit Beteiligung von Akteuren aus der Wirtschaft und aus dem Startup-Bereich. Du kannst relevante Akteure zeitnah identifizieren und sie mit unseren Zielgruppen vernetzen. Du besitzt Erfahrungen mit Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen oder Collective-Impact-Ansätzen. Du bewegst dich sicher im Umgang mit Entscheider*innen auf Konzern- beziehungsweise Leitungsebene. • Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Gewinnung von Partner*innen, Kund*innen oder Förder*innen sowie in der eigenverantwortlichen Leitung komplexer Projekte. Deine Vorteile bei uns Purpose • Ein sinnstiftender Job mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. • Die Möglichkeit, an relevanten gesellschaftlichen Themen wie nachhaltige Wirtschaft, Stärkung von Demokratie und Klimaschutz mitzuarbeiten. • Eine Organisation, die danach strebt, eine Vielfalt an Identitäten, Erfahrungshintergründen und Perspektiven zusammenzubringen. • Ein großes Netzwerk an Kontakten aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Zivilgesellschaft. What awaits you: You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts. You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues. You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process. You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development. You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working. Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients. What you can expect: At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective. You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups. You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting. What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. What you bring along: You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups. Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself We look forward to meeting you! title: Creative Strategist - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description: About Placetel We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future. Tasks Your role As Creative Strategist you own the single biggest lever in our paid social performance: the creative. Meta is your home channel. You decide what we test, you make sure enough of it exists, and you read the results well enough to know why the winner won. We are B2B, but we intend to build like a consumer brand. German SMB owners scroll the same feed as everyone else, and they do not stop for a product screenshot with a feature list. Your job is to make them stop – and then to make them start a trial. What you will do Own the creative engine for paid social – primarily Meta, with TikTok and YouTube as we expand. Turn insight into angles: mine customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls, churn reasons, competitor ads and customer conversations for what German SMBs actually say about their phone system, their calls and their missed business. Build and run a creative testing roadmap: a steady, predictable volume of new concepts every week, structured by angle, format and hook so results are readable rather than anecdotal. Write scripts, hooks and storyboards for short-form video – UGC, founder- and employee-led, testimonial, problem/solution, product demo, static and everything in between. Brief and direct creators, editors, actors and freelancers, run shoots, and manage the production pipeline end to end so throughput never becomes the bottleneck. Analyse creative performance at the right level with the Performance Marketing Manager – hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and trial rate per angle – and decide what to iterate, scale or kill. Maintain a living library of winners, losers and learnings so we compound instead of restarting every quarter. Systematically tear down what works elsewhere – in DTC, in consumer, at other AI and SaaS brands – and transfer the pattern to us. Keep everything on brand and legally clean while still being genuinely entertaining. Requirements Who we are looking for A track record of paid social creative that actually performed at scale, above all on Meta. Bring examples – and the numbers behind them. You think in hooks and in the first three seconds. You can explain why an ad works, not just that it does. You write and judge German copy at native level; solid English on top. Production-capable, not only conceptual: when speed matters you can shoot and cut a usable ad yourself. Comfortable with volume – dozens of variations a month, not three perfect films a quarter. Data-literate: you can navigate Ads Manager reporting and draw your own conclusions without waiting for a dashboard. Strong opinions about creative, loosely held – you let the results decide and you kill your darlings quickly. Agency or in-house experience at a DTC, consumer or high-velocity SaaS brand is a strong plus. Optional - nice to have Experience building and managing a creator or UGC network. Experience with AI-supported creative production (generative video, voice, image, automated variation). Experience with landing page and post-click creative, not just the ad itself. Benefits What we offer Real creative ownership: you set the testing agenda, not an agency. A budget that makes creative testing meaningful and a performance team that will actually read your results. The freedom to build a B2B brand that behaves like a consumer brand – with an AI-native product that gives you something genuinely new to talk about. A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality. Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance. Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI. Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included. Open, collegial company culture with regular team events. title: Director of Sales, Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Based in London, the Director NATO &amp; Nordics will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.</p> <p>As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.</li> <li>Forecast Governance &amp; Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.</li> <li>Capture Strategy &amp; Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.</li> <li>Manage, Coach &amp; Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.</li> <li>Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.</li> <li>Talent Bench &amp; Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.</li> <li>Technical &amp; Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.</li> <li>Deal Cadence &amp; Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.</li> <li>Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.</li> <li>Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).</li> <li>Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).</li> <li>An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.</li> <li>Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.</li> <li>A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.</li> <li><span style="color: #1d1c1d; background-color: #f8f8f8;">Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.</li> <li>Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.</li> <li>Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>December 8, 2026 at 11:59p PT</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. title: Senior Account Manager - Maritime- Northwest Europe
description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About the Role As a Senior Account Manager for our Maritime division in EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue expansion across key accounts in Northwest Europe. You will partner with industry leaders, transforming complex maritime data into high-value commercial solutions that power their strategic decisions. By nurturing long-term relationships and proactively identifying expansion opportunities, you directly accelerate Kpler’s growth footprint across the regional trade ecosystem.   Key Responsibilities Drive portfolio revenue growth across Northwest Europe by managing key maritime accounts and consistently exceeding annual sales targets. The Recruiting Coordinator partners closely with recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and cross-functional teams to anticipate and resolve coordination challenges and support the successful execution of global hiring initiatives.

As an experienced member of the Talent Acquisition team, this role also serves as a resource for recruiting coordination best practices, identifies opportunities to improve operational processes, and helps establish scalable and consistent ways of working as the organization grows.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Interview Coordination

  • Independently manage high-volume and complex interview scheduling across multiple countries and global time zones
  • Coordinate complex calendars involving candidates, interview panels, hiring managers, executives, and other key stakeholders
  • Arrange virtual and in-person interviews, including multi-stage and multi-day interview processes
  • Anticipate scheduling constraints and proactively identify solutions to minimize delays and ensure an efficient hiring process
  • Prepare and distribute accurate interview confirmations, calendar invitations, interview schedules, and relevant materials
  • Manage last-minute scheduling changes and competing priorities with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Ensure interview details and candidate activity are accurately maintained within Talent Acquisition systems
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to determine effective scheduling approaches for complex or business-critical searches
  • Serve as a resource to the Talent Acquisition team on interview coordination practices and processes

Candidate Travel & Logistics

  • Independently coordinate domestic and international candidate travel, including flights and accommodations
  • Prepare and distribute detailed candidate itineraries and ensure candidates have the information necessary for a seamless interview experience
  • Coordinate complex or time-sensitive travel arrangements across multiple EMEA locations
  • Manage travel changes, cancellations, disruptions, and other unexpected issues while minimizing impact to candidates and interview teams
  • Ensure candidate travel arrangements comply with applicable company travel policies and budget guidelines
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors, as appropriate, to resolve travel and logistical issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve candidate travel processes, documentation, and operational consistency

Candidate Experience

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, providing timely, professional, and high-touch support
  • Deliver clear and proactive communication to candidates across multiple countries and time zones
  • Anticipate candidate questions and logistical needs and proactively address issues that could affect the interview experience
  • Ensure a consistent, organized, and positive candidate experience throughout all stages of interview coordination
  • Exercise discretion and professionalism when supporting sensitive, confidential, executive, or business-critical searches
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to continuously improve the candidate experience

Recruiting Operations Support

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely candidate and interview data within Applicant Tracking Systems and other Talent Acquisition tools
  • Support recruiting metrics, reporting, audits, and operational tracking as needed
  • Monitor coordination workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and stakeholder experience
  • Recommend and support implementation of improvements to scheduling, candidate travel, documentation, and recruiting coordination processes
  • Develop and maintain recruiting coordination resources, documentation, templates, and standard operating procedures
  • Support adoption of recruiting tools, processes, and operational best practices across the Talent Acquisition organization
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource for recruiting coordination processes and provide guidance to recruiters, coordinators, and hiring teams as needed
  • Support onboarding and mentoring of recruiting coordinators or other Talent Acquisition team members, as appropriate
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Talent Acquisition, PX, Finance, hiring teams, and other business partners to support hiring initiatives
  • Support special projects and evolving Talent Acquisition priorities as the organization scales

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR/PX operations, or a related role, including experience independently managing complex recruiting logistics

Preferred Qualifications

business-critical information.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.</li> <li>Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.</li> <li>Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.</li> <li>Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.</li> <li>Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.</li> <li>Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.</li> <li>An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.</li> <li>A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.</li> <li>Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.</li> <li>Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.</li> <li>Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.</li> <li>Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.</li> <li>Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>We are seeking a highly collaborative and strategic Business Operations Manager<strong>&nbsp;(Product Data Insights &amp; Reporting)</strong> to serve as the vital operational bridge between our technical data execution and cross-functional business decision-making. In this role, you will lead the effort to transform product and organizational data into actionable insights for our Product and Engineering organization, driving alignment and helping senior leadership make high-impact decisions.</p> <p>You are an exceptional relationship builder, translator, and team advocate. Rather than focusing on hands-on technical execution, your strength lies in your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, influence stakeholders across diverse teams, and translate complex data points into compelling narratives that drive business outcomes.</p> <p><strong>You impact</strong></p> <ol> <li>Establish deep, trusting partnerships with engineering and product stakeholders as well as cross-functional leadership, acting as the primary strategic bridge between analytical execution and business decision-making.</li> <li>Translate analytical projects into highly compelling narratives, framing our roadmap in a way that resonates with senior stakeholders and drives meaningful alignment.</li> <li>Navigate organizational dynamics and competing priorities with high political acumen, ensuring data-backed recommendations are successfully adopted and operationalized.</li> <li>Maintain stakeholder momentum and manage expectations gracefully during long delivery cycles, keeping partners excited and bought into the long-term analytics vision.</li> <li>Advocate passionately for the analytics function, leveraging high demand for insights to build compelling cases for expanded support.</li> <li>Lead, mentor, and protect a lean team of technical analysts, providing the necessary "air cover" for them to focus on deep execution while actively coaching them on communication and influencing skills.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Your Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong experience within the technology industry</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of product operations, business insights, program management, or a related role—ideally within a fast-paced SaaS, product, or engineering organization.</li> <li>A strong background of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, executive presence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among senior leadership.</li> <li>Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance) and successfully influencing decision-making without direct authority.</li> <li>Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical data into simple, actionable insights for senior leadership.</li> <li>Ability to manage a high volume of incoming requests, establish clear operational triage frameworks, and comfortably manage stakeholder expectations.</li> <li>A solid understanding of how product analytics and reporting structures operate (e.g., data flows, modeling, or visualization tools) to effectively translate technical needs, though hands-on coding/modeling is not required.</li> <li>Deep understanding of modern development methodologies (e.g., Agile, SAFe) and the product lifecycle in a SaaS context.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. Please contact us to request accommodation. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong> &nbsp;</p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not: &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. &nbsp;</li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. &nbsp;</p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.</p> <p>You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.</p> <p>The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.</li> <li>Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.</li> <li>Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.</li> <li>Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.</li> <li>Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.</li> <li>Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.</li> <li>A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.</li> <li>Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.</li> <li>A strong data foundation: you can design an experiment, read eval results critically, and tell a real quality improvement from noise.</li> <li>Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.</li> <li>Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution without losing the thread.</li> <li>The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">It will be an added bonus if you have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;<br></span></p> <ul> <li>Depth in information retrieval, NLP, or applied machine learning beyond what the role requires.</li> <li>Experience with index tiering, sharding, freshness pipelines, or cost-per-query optimisation at scale.</li> <li>Experience with hybrid retrieval, semantic and lexical search, re-ranking, or human evaluation programs.</li> <li>Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses running both self-serve and enterprise motions.</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. What You'll Achieve Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. Skills You'll Need to Bring 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.


The Role

We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.


You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.


That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.


What You'll Do

  • Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

  • Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

  • Shape and lead 6-week Shape Up cycles for new features and provider integrations

  • Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows

  • Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete

  • Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own

  • Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets

  • Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it

What We're Looking For

  • Product experience at lead, staff or principal level. Strong senior candidates are in scope if the rest lines up

  • An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product

  • You've owned the vision and strategy for an area, not just executed against someone else's

  • Comfortable with fluid scope. You've picked up an unfamiliar domain before and become useful quickly

  • Genuine cross-business collaboration. You've worked with support, success and sales, not only with engineers and designers with the occasional customer call

  • You come from an environment with a high quality bar. It usually shows in the product itself

  • Clear, concise communication, spoken and written, focused on value and outcomes rather than process

  • Scale-up experience, roughly Series A to D. Seed-stage experience on top of that is a plus

  • Comfortable managing people, or ready to start

  • Domain experience. Fintech or Insurtech is the closest match to what you'll work on, then HR tech, benefits, employee expenses or travel. Anything sold to an employer that employees then use. The business model matters more than the industry label: if you've had to serve both an HR buyer and the employees using the product, that's the experience we care about


Not every box needs ticking. We'd rather see someone strong on several of these and light on others than someone who technically matches everything.

Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this every day.

Kota Benefits

  • Health Insurance via Kota

  • Workplace Pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (country dependent)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office needs

  • Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need

  • Annual company-wide offsite and dedicated team offsite

Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things simple and respectful of your time.

  • Screening call (30 mins) with our talent team: your background, what you're looking for, and the practicalities

  • Competency interview (60 mins) with one of our Product Leads, covering how you work, what you've owned and how you make product calls

  • Task session (60 mins) with our GM and one other, working through a real Insurances problem together

  • Call with founders (30 mins) with our CEO and CTO: our vision, and your thoughts on it

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. What We’re Looking For Growth marketing strategist: You treat marketing spend as a portfolio of investments, not a cost center. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. You have an informed opinion on how brand spend, paid acquisition, and organic loops interact, and you back it with data. Technical and data-driven : Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). Service-first partner : You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams. High-slope learner : You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10. Experience : 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required. What You’ll Do Drive marketing efficiency & planning: Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline. Build and own channel-level unit economics: Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go. Connect marketing performance to company outcomes: Work across the organization to ensure marketing investment ties to measurable business results. Analyze market trends, competitive spend, and channel dynamics to inform forward-looking strategy and ensure capital is deployed where it compounds. Accelerate with AI: Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer.
